refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.SysUpdate is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs to manage system updates interface io.systemd.SysUpdate
# Class of a Target. type TargetClass( # Container or machine managed by systemd-machined.service(8). machine, # Portable service. portable, # System extension managed by systemd-sysext.service(8). sysext, # Configuration extension managed by systemd-confext.service(8). confext, # Host system. host, # Component managed by systemd-sysupdate.service(8). component )
# Identifier for a component of the system (i.e. the host itself, a sysext, a confext, etc.) that can be updated by systemd-sysupdate(8). type TargetIdentifier( # Where the target was enumerated. class: TargetClass, # Name of the target, unique within a class. name: ?string )
# Type containing a configured sysupdate target. type Target( # Identifier for the target. id: TargetIdentifier )
# Type containing a configured sysupdate feature. type Feature( # Identifier for the feature. id: string, # A short human readable description of the feature. description: ?string, # URLs to documentation for the feature. documentation: ?[]string, # A URL to an AppStream catalog XML file describing the feature. appstream: ?string, # Whether the feature is enabled. isEnabled: bool, # Array of IDs of the transfers (including currently disabled ones) which are controlled by this feature. transfers: ?[]string )
# Show optional features method ListFeatures( # Target to list features for. target: TargetIdentifier ) -> ( # The configured features. features: []Feature )
# Check if there’s a new version available method CheckNew( # Target to check for updates for. target: TargetIdentifier, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # The version string for the new version which is available. available: string )
# Show targets method ListTargets() -> ( # The configured targets. targets: []Target )
# Error indicating that no update is currently available to update to. error NoUpdateNeeded()
# Error indicating the specified target doesn’t exist error NoSuchTarget()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.SysUpdate shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.SysUpdate.ListFeatures '{}' invokes its ListFeatures method.
